### David Spares Saul’s Life
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/david-spares-sauls-life
Passage: 1 Samuel 24:20-21
Points:
- Saul experienced a lucid moment, acknowledging that David would reign and pleading for his family's preservation.
- David refused to kill Saul because he honored the Lord's anointed and waited on God's timing.
- David rested in God's sovereignty rather than seizing the promised kingdom through sinful, illicit means.
- Showing mercy to an enemy demonstrated the transforming work of divine grace in David's heart.
- Believers are instructed to leave vengeance to God rather than taking justice into their own hands.

### A Clear Conscience
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living Ministries
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/a-clear-conscience
Passage: 1 Samuel 24:16-19
Points:
- David spoke directly to Saul with integrity, leaving final judgment entirely to the Lord.
- Saul wept and confessed that David had shown extraordinary mercy by repaying evil with kindness.
- Responding righteously can disarm an opponent, but we cannot guarantee that every enemy will repent.
- Believers are responsible for speaking truth in love regardless of how others respond.
- Dealing with adversaries with uprightness provides the enduring reward of a clear conscience.
